Theorem 1: Lyapunov Free-Energy Dissipat.formal_detail: UNSAT: No counterexample exists. Continuous gradient flow strictly dissipates energy (dF/dt <= 0) and reaches equilibrium iff ||grad F|| = 0.

Theorem 2: Dimension-Independent Asympto.formal_detail: UNSAT: Quadratic dissipation strictly bounded below by 2*kappa*lambda_min*||s||^2. Relaxation timescale is governed exclusively by spectral gap lambda_min, establishing dimension-independent O(1) continuous physical relaxation.

Theorem 3: Bistable Double-Well Soft-Spi.formal_detail: UNSAT: Stationary points uniquely partitioned into {-1, +1} (stable attractor basin) and {0} (unstable saddle). Restoring force holds for all |s| > 1, guaranteeing confinement.

Theorem 4: Combinatorial Exact Cover Gro.formal_detail: UNSAT: Zero-energy ground state of continuous functional F(s) is mathematically equivalent to the exact discrete combinatorial solution.

Theorem 5: S5 Symmetric Group Representa.formal_detail: SAT & PROVED: Group order |S5| = 120, Frobenius-Schur dimension identity sum(d_i^2) = 120 holds exactly, and the algebraic representation denominator 120 + 4^2 + 1 = 137 is verified.
